description: Data Scientist, real estate ontology MRI Software is hiring Data Scientists to turn a real estate ontology into products: the models, agents and analytics that only become possible when every property, lease, tenant, asset and transaction is described in one shared, machine-readable language. About the role MRI is building a Common Data Model that unifies data across its product portfolio. On top of it we are creating a real estate ontology: the entities, relationships, rules and semantics of the industry. You will be among the first data scientists to work on that foundation. Your job is to discover what can be built on it, prove it with working models and prototypes, and hand the winners to product teams. This is a research-to-product role. Expect to spend as much time finding the right problem as solving it. What you will do Help turn the Common Data Model into a real estate ontology: entities, relationships, constraints and business rules across leasing, property operations, assets, investments, and facilities. Explore the ontology with data to find high-value solutions: forecasting, anomaly detection, entity resolution, Decision modeling / recommendation, valuation signals, and portfolio optimization. Build and validate models on real product data from across the MRI portfolio, with clear baselines and honest evaluation. Prototype ontology-grounded AI: knowledge-graph retrieval, LLM agents that reason over typed entities, and natural-language analytics with a semantic layer. Define metrics and a semantic layer so that a number means the same thing in every product. Partner with product, engineering and domain experts to move proven prototypes into the MRI platform. Raise the bar on data quality: find mapping gaps, bad joins and silent failures, and feed them back into the model. What you bring Required Bachelor's or master's or PhD (from Premier Institute) in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, Physics or a related quantitative field 3-5 years of applied data science experience Strong foundations in statistics, probability, optimization and machine learning, and the judgment to know when a simple model is enough. Fluent Python and SQL; comfort with modern data stacks (Spark, a cloud warehouse such as Snowflake or Databricks, dbt or similar). Hands-on experience with at least one of: knowledge graphs, ontologies or semantic modelling, entity resolution, or LLM-based applications (retrieval, agents, evaluation). Strong verbal and written communication skills Strong plus Experience in real estate, proptech, finance, or any other asset-heavy domains. (preferred not mandatory) Published research, patents, competition results, or open-source work. Experience taking a model from notebook to production with MLOps practices. description: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Office Job Description As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. DESCRIPTION: The Workday Time & Absence Implementation Lead / Project Manager will be part of Thermo Fisher Scientific’s Human Resources Technology Services (HRTS) team, with dual responsibility for leading Workday Time Tracking and Absence project workstreams and serving as the hands-on functional and configuration lead. With support from the Workday Time and Absence Architect and Program Leads, this role will lead Time Tracking and Absence implementations associated with M&A and payroll transformation initiatives from requirements and design through configuration, testing, deployment, and stabilization. The individual will directly configure Workday while managing project scope, schedule, risks, dependencies, resources, and deliverables. The role will coordinate cross-functional teams, implementation partners, and consultants and partner with HR, Payroll, IT, Finance, Legal/Compliance, and business stakeholders. The successful candidate will combine strong Workday Time Tracking and Absence expertise with project management capabilities to deliver scalable solutions addressing complex business, payroll, policy, and regulatory requirements. This role offers the opportunity to advance technological solutions while supporting our mission of enabling customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. RESPONSIBILITIES: Workday Time & Absence Solution Leadership and Configuration · Serve as functional and configuration lead for Workday Time Tracking and Absence implementations, including M&A, divestitures, payroll transformations, and other HR technology initiatives. · Lead discovery and requirements activities covering business processes, time and absence practices, policies, payroll dependencies, regulatory requirements, and technology. · Perform fit-gap assessments against Thermo Fisher Scientific’s Workday configuration and global standards and translate requirements into scalable solutions. · Design, configure, test, and deploy Workday Absence solutions, including time-off plans, leave types, accruals, eligibility rules, business processes, and workflows. · Design, configure, test, and deploy Workday Time Tracking solutions, including eligibility, workflows, overtime rules, differentials, time calculations, and related payroll earnings. · Prototype solutions with stakeholders, identify gaps, evaluate alternatives, and assess impacts across HCM, Payroll, Compensation, security, and integrations. · Partner with integration and payroll teams on third-party payroll interfaces and time, absence, employee, and payroll data. · Maintain required functional, configuration, design, and test documentation. Project and Workstream Leadership · With support from Program/Project Leads and the Workday Time and Absence Architect, lead Time Tracking and Absence workstreams through planning, design, configuration, testing, deployment, cutover, and stabilization. · Develop and manage workstream plans covering scope, schedule, resources, milestones, dependencies, deliverables, and governance. · Coordinate internal teams, Workday consultants, implementation partners, and vendors, ensuring accountability for deliverables. · Identify and mitigate risks and issues, develop remediation plans, and escalate key decisions and dependencies as appropriate. · Lead workstream governance and communicate project status, risks, issues, and decisions to stakeholders using applicable project management standards and tools. · Manage multiple concurrent initiatives while maintaining alignment with program objectives and milestones. · Oversee partner and vendor deliverables, resources, timelines, budgets, and contractual commitments as applicable. Testing, Deployment and Quality Assurance · Lead Time Tracking and Absence testing, including test strategy, scenarios, defect management, and functional, integration, payroll, regression, and user acceptance testing. · Review solution designs, configurations, specifications, test plans, and other deliverables for quality and completeness. · Lead deployment readiness and cutover activities, including configuration migration, data validation, integration and business readiness, and go-live activities. · Provide functional and project leadership during stabilization and hypercare and ensure successful transition to operational support. Qualifications · Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Human Resources, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience. · 5+ years of experience with Tier 1 HCM systems and HR technology implementations, including application configuration and complex technology projects. · Strong hands-on functional and configuration experience with Workday Time Tracking and Absence Management or equivalent Tier 1 HCM solutions. · Experience leading HR technology projects or workstreams in a global, matrixed organization. · Experience across the project lifecycle, including requirements, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, and stabilization. · Strong knowledge of Time Tracking and Absence processes and their dependencies with Payroll and other HCM processes. · Experience with M&A, divestitures, enterprise transformations, employee migrations, or similar cross-functional initiatives is strongly preferred. · Understanding of HR processes, HR data, and enterprise HCM systems, including impacts of organizational, policy, and system changes. · Knowledge of Workday HCM, Payroll, Compensation, security, business processes, and integrations is preferred. Skills and Competencies · Functional & Project Leadership: Ability to serve as both a hands-on Workday configuration expert and project workstream leader, managing scope, schedules, dependencies, risks, and delivery. · Workday Expertise: Strong understanding of Workday Time Tracking and Absence configuration, business processes, dependencies, and implementation methodology. · Partner & Stakeholder Management: Ability to coordinate consultants, vendors, internal teams, and stakeholders across functions and organizational levels. · Problem Solving: Strong analytical skills with the ability to evaluate complex requirements and recommend practical solutions. · Communication: Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, including communicating technical concepts in user-friendly language. · Execution: Highly organized, self-motivated, and able to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, global environment while maintaining quality and customer focus.

Day-to-day support: pick up broader operational and data tasks as capacity and trust grow — this role is designed to expand, not stay fixed. description: Business Analyst II Are you a strategic planner and problem-solver? Are you looking to develop your Data Analyst career? About the Team: Mercury is RX’s global registration and eCommerce platform, supporting the journeys that bring visitors and exhibitors into our events. Its capabilities span registration, purchasing, badging and onsite access, connecting customer experiences with the data and business systems behind them. We work across Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Product Success and regional business teams to deliver reliable services, improve customer experiences and create measurable business value. About the Role We’re seeking a Business Analyst with a strong focus on User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to bridge product delivery and business validation. You’ll coordinate testing, help business users evaluate new features, manage feedback, and communicate releases in clear, accessible language. The focus is hands-on business acceptance and coordination—not software development or test automation engineering. Responsibilities (What you’ll do) Plan and coordinate business acceptance testing Partner with Product Managers, Product Owners, and Business Analysts to understand desired outcomes, user journeys, business rules, and acceptance criteria. Turn requirements into practical, risk-based UAT scenarios covering standard journeys, exceptions, and relevant regional variations. Coordinate testing scope and schedules, providing participants with clear instructions, test-event links, and prerequisites. Work with engineering, QA, and configuration teams to ensure environments, test data, and configurations are ready before testing. Perform hands-on business validation and help users investigate and reproduce unexpected results. Manage feedback, defects, and acceptance evidence Maintain a consolidated record of business feedback and communicate test completion, outstanding observations, and potential enhancements. Separate defects from configuration issues, clarification requests, and enhancement ideas, working with product and technical teams to agree next steps. Document reproducible issues, including expected and actual results, supporting evidence, and business impact, and coordinate retesting after fixes. Report progress, coverage, blockers, and residual risks so decision-makers can clearly assess readiness. Coordinate acceptance evidence and follow-up while keeping approval and validation accountability with the relevant Business Units. Support release communication and continuous improvement Prepare business-facing release updates that explain what changed, why it matters, and any relevant limitations or actions. Keep testing guidance, feedback records, and supporting documentation accessible to global stakeholders. Create reusable scenarios and checklists to improve consistency and reduce repeated effort across releases. Apply lessons from UAT and production issues to strengthen future acceptance coverage and identify gaps earlier. Collaborate across regions and time zones, keeping dependencies, decisions, and ownership clear. Requirements (What you’ll bring) Practical experience in UAT, business analysis, functional testing, or a similar role supporting user-facing digital products. Experience translating requirements and business processes into clear acceptance criteria and end-to-end test scenarios. Ability to organize testing with business users, balance competing priorities, and follow issues through to documented outcomes. Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to explain business impact as well as technical symptoms. Clear written and verbal communication skills, including experience producing user guidance, test summaries, and release updates. Experience with issue-tracking and collaborative documentation tools such as Jira and Confluence, or equivalents. Understanding of Agile delivery and the differences between engineering QA, business acceptance, and release approval. A collaborative approach and confidence working with technical and non-technical stakeholders in a distributed team. Useful, but not essential, skills Experience with event registration, ticketing, eCommerce, or other transaction-based customer journeys. Familiarity with payments, invoicing, discounts, upgrades, entitlements, or integrations between customer-facing and back-office systems. Exposure to onsite operational tools, badge management, or access-control workflows. Awareness of accessibility, localization, and data-quality considerations in business acceptance testing. Experience with test-management tools, basic data queries, or API-testing tools to support investigations. What success looks like Business users know what to test, how to participate, and where to provide feedback. Critical business journeys have clear acceptance coverage and traceable results. Defects and feedback are actionable, assigned, and followed through, with unresolved risks visible before release decisions. Business approvers receive concise evidence to support acceptance decisions. Release communications clearly explain changes and limitations, helping teams prepare for adoption. Reusable guidance and lessons learned make each testing cycle more effective. Why join us? Help shape digital experiences that connect online registration with the live event experience. title: QA Analyst - Intern
description: Job Description: Intern: QA Analyst About Us: UpEnergy is the leading developer of anti-poverty climate impact projects in Africa. We accelerate decarbonization and while delivering long-term health and income benefits in local communities. We provide life-improving clean technologies and carbon reduction and capture projects that protect the local environment, deliver health benefits and cleaner air, and reduce poverty through financial savings and employment. Our project sustainably benefits and enables people to live better lives within more climate resilient communities. To date, UpEnergy has built over 95 emission reduction projects, impacted over 4 million lives, and reduced over 3 million tons of CO2 Emissions across 10 countries. All UpEnergy’s work is characterized by respect for the people we serve, rigorous measurement, deep local knowledge and established teams on the ground to ensure the highest impact and results. We do all this through our commitment to drive long-term business growth through technical innovation, close customer engagement and increased data-driven decision making. The UpEnergy team continues to grow, across multiple African countries, from 20 to over 170+ full time team members in the past two years, reflecting the growth of the company for which we now seek incredible, like-minded talent who are excited to join us in delivering even more impact. Learn more here: UpEnergy Group Why This Role As Carbon Data & QC Ops grows in scale and complexity — more markets, more monthly cycles, more deliverables going to field teams, leadership, auditors and registries — quality and consistency checks need a dedicated owner. This role builds that layer: a second pair of eyes across the team's output before it ships, so reliability doesn't depend on one person catching everything alone. The role starts high-level — general quality assurance across data, forms, reports and tools. As trust and familiarity build, scope naturally grows into broader day-to-day operational support. Role Summary Own quality assurance across the team's deliverables — data, forms, reports, dashboards, and working tools — catching errors early and keeping output reliable and consistent before it goes out. Key Responsibilities Quality review: check deliverables — data outputs, forms, reports, dashboards — for accuracy and consistency before they ship. Source verification: spot-check numbers and records against source data. Review logging: keep a simple, current log of what was checked and what was found — no review without a record. Early escalation: flag anything uncertain the same day rather than guess or sit on it. Day-to-day support: pick up broader operational and data tasks as capacity and trust grow — this role is designed to expand, not stay fixed. Candidate Profile Must-Haves High attention to detail; methodical and comfortable with repetitive, precision-dependent work. Clear written communication — much of the work is asynchronous review and reporting. Proactive problem-solver — surfaces issues with a proposed fix, not just a flag. Reliable and self-directed; this role runs on a checklist and a log, not close supervision. Nice-to-Haves (bonus, not gating) Familiarity with survey/data-collection tools (e.g. XLSForm, SurveyCTO, ODK, KoboToolbox). Basic SQL and/or Python — enough to spot-check a query or re-run a script and read its output. Prior exposure to carbon markets, M&E, or program data — shortens ramp-up, not required. Explicitly Not Required Not a developer hire — no new feature-building or software-engineering expected. No prior carbon-credit or MRV expertise required. What You'll Gain Direct, hands-on mentorship from the Senior Data Analyst on real carbon-market data and operations — not shadow work, actual production deliverables. Broad exposure across data, forms, reporting and tooling — a strong general foundation, not a narrow niche. Growing ownership — the role expands as trust builds, not a role capped at one task forever. A structured ramp-up with regular feedback, not thrown in blind. Decision Rights Tier What it covers Flags & logs — no ask needed Any discrepancy found during review, however small. Decides independently Obvious fixes (typos, formatting); re-running a check after correcting an input error. Never their call What ships externally; final sign-off on anything going to leadership, auditors or registries — that stays with Shoaib. Success — First 90 Days Deliverables going out to field teams or leadership have an independent check behind them. A current, complete review log exists and reflects real work — no gaps. The role has picked up at least one recurring day-to-day task beyond pure review. Practical Details Reports to: Shoaib Ahmed Noorani, Senior Data Analyst, Carbon Data & QC Ops. Engagement: Full-time preferred; initial 3-month trial with extension based on performance. Location: In Office (Bangalore) Why Join Us? Not your average 9-to-5 UpEnergy encourages teamwork, creativity, and we’re not afraid to get our hands dirty. We stay close to our market, understand our customers, and have a lot of fun while doing our work! If you’re looking for a conventional 9-to-5, you’d be missing out on our adventures! Opportunity to do things in a new way As one of the largest compliance credit issuer in Africa, we need to be constantly improving and rethinking our way of work. This means endless opportunities for a self-starter to initiate new ways of doing things or experimenting ways to help us improve. Personal and Career Growth Wouldn’t it be a pity to spend so much time working but not growing and learning? At UpEnergy we value both personal and professional growth, and we want to grow as a team. From classroom training to coffee chats to performance review, we want to support every team member to grow into the best version they can. Create Lasting Impact Our clean energy products bring positive impact to both our planet earth and for the low-income communities we work in. We don’t just focus on sales – we follow up and truly understand our customers to make sure that they continue to benefit from our products. Your work will create much longer-lasting impact than what you can see! Compensation: The Intern will receive a stipend. Internship Duration: 6 months Start date & Location: The position is based in Chennai, India. We are looking for the right candidate to start as soon as possible.

Hands-on experience with submission platforms such as Scholar One Manuscripts, Editorial Manager, or similar. Experience working in a client-facing service delivery environment is preferred. Key Skills & Competencies Sound knowledge of tools, databases, and strategies for identifying suitable reviewers. Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to deliver high-quality service to external customers. People management skills, including coaching, feedback delivery, and conflict resolution. Strong planning and organizational ability to manage workload distribution, deadlines, and team capacity. Analytical mindset, comfortable working with data to identify trends and drive improvements Roles & Responsibilities: 1. Reviewer Selection Expertise Maintain strong working knowledge of tools, databases, and strategies for identifying reviewers who align with customer and journal expectations. Guide and support the team in resolving complex or escalated reviewer selection cases. 2. Journal & Workload Assignment Assign journals/titles to team members based on team capacity, complexity of the title, and individual skill levels. Rebalance assignments as volumes fluctuate, ensuring fair and efficient distribution of work across the team. Plan and arrange cover for planned and unplanned absences (leaves, sudden attrition) so client deliverables face no disruption. Build and maintain a succession plan for key roles in the team, identifying and developing potential backups or future leads. Cross-train team members across journals/clients to build bench strength and reduce dependency on any single individual. 3. Deliverable Tracking & TAT Adherence Track day-to-day completion of deliverables against agreed timelines for every team member. Monitor turnaround time (TAT) adherence at both individual and team level; identify slippages early and course-correct before they escalate. Maintain and share trackers/dashboards reflecting daily and weekly status with reporting manager and the customer. 4. Communication and Process Coordination Facilitate communication between editorial teams and external internal stakeholders, ensuring review progress on schedule. Proactively flag risks, delays, or difficulties to the reporting manager and/or client well in advance, along with a proposed mitigation plan, rather than waiting for the issue to surface as an escalation. 5. Quality Control Ensure quality of the reviewer selection process delivered by the team, with a focus on credible reviewer choices and high agree rates. Plan and conduct periodic quality audits/spot-checks on team output and provide constructive feedback. 6. Hiring & Workforce Planning Partner with HR/Talent Acquisition to plan hiring in line with projected volumes and anticipated attrition. Ensure timely replacement of resigned or transitioned team members by proactively raising requisitions and following up to avoid service gaps. Participate in interviews and the selection process for new hires joining the team. 7. Training & Onboarding Design and deliver structured onboarding for new joiners on reviewer selection processes, tools, and submission platforms. Conduct periodic refresher training and skill-upgrade sessions to keep the existing team current on process changes and best practices. 9. Performance Management Set clear performance expectations and goals for each team member; conduct periodic one-on-ones and formal performance reviews. Identify underperformance early, put together improvement plans, and recognize/reward good performance. 10. Data Analysis & Process Improvement Analyze data on reviewer selection effectiveness, agree rates, and TAT performance to identify trends and root causes. Recommend and implement process improvements to enhance speed and quality of reviewer selection. • Maintain accurate records of reviewer selection activity and keep content/submission management systems updated. 12. Stakeholder Management Manage the expectations of client and editorial stakeholders through transparent, professional, and proactive communication. Act as the primary point of contact for the team's deliverables, representing the team in internal and client review discussions. All the interested canddiates, please share your updated profile to kishan.babu@luminad.com
